title: Coordinate exact FE/BFF release candidate and dev deployment switch

owned: Pantheon cross-repository gate and deploy dispatcher
Pantheon nonprod exact-dev-tip admission and compensation routing
execute-plans controller-only gate artifact and FE deploy admission
paired rollback evidence and nonprod delivery documentation
not_changing: runtime Compose manifest owned by L12-MANIFEST-001

acceptance.criterion: A single immutable release candidate record binds exact Pantheon and execute-plans commits before deployment.
acceptance.evidence: agora_compat_manifest.py derives release_candidate_id from both commit/tree identities and the exact generated manifest; nonprod-deploy uploads the ledger and rollback baseline before Deploy dev VM stack under lease.

acceptance.criterion: Admission fails closed unless manifests match and compatibility_status is compatible.
acceptance.evidence: Both execute-plans workflows independently regenerate the Pantheon manifest and require compatible candidate ID, manifest digest, and exact FE/BFF commits.

acceptance.criterion: FE is built and smoke tested against the exact BFF candidate before public switch.
acceptance.evidence: The controller waits for the exact integration-gate run; only its hard-gated controller-dispatch artifact can enter pantheon-dev-fe-deploy, whose existing deploy controller probes before the symlink switch.

acceptance.criterion: The dev switch is atomic or compensated with rollback proof.
acceptance.evidence: execute-plans retains atomic FE rollback; Pantheon compensation restores the baseline BFF under a fresh lease and requires both hosted FE/BFF identities before writing compensation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: The workflow refuses out-of-order or main-branch frontend delivery.
acceptance.evidence: Pantheon and both execute-plans workflows require the exact current protected dev tips and exact dev workflow-run identity.

acceptance.criterion: No intermediate hosted deployment is triggered for individual fixes.
acceptance.evidence: Pantheon publish pushes no longer trigger nonprod dev; execute-plans dev pushes no longer upload deployable artifacts and workflow_run no longer triggers FE deploy.

acceptance.criterion: Both repository PR, review, checks, merge, and evidence are complete.
acceptance.evidence: Codex independently approved Pantheon b25b269956dc24eab3a2fc12b76bf731810c143f and execute-plans 1081deb765c5313731ae5813ee6f3d618e7103cd after exact-head validation. PR #4268 merged as b854c2bdeba672d107314c51c7588455be96221e and PR #558 merged as f24c26330c7fb5afe6c2f1c735ea5fb06b3d87ef into their dev branches.

decision.summary: Codex approved both exact heads after independently passing 64 directly affected Pantheon tests, 58 execute-plans tests plus typecheck, syntax and diff checks, repository-boundary checks, and the exact GitHub check evidence. The review confirmed exact-pair admission, controller-only FE delivery, BFF-first atomic-or-compensated switching, dev-only ordering, safe defaults, and no intermediate hosted deployment.

closeout.merge_verification: Both independently reviewed heads and both merge commits are ancestors of their repository origin/dev refs.

merge_controls.pantheon_root_release_context: Root live gate released for reviewed closeout PR #4268 only
merge_controls.github_review_reconciliation: Pantheon had one GitHub collaborator, so its last-pusher approval requirement could not be satisfied by a distinct GitHub identity even though canonical reviewer Codex had independently approved the exact head. After all required contexts passed and no other open PR held the root release context, required_approving_review_count and require_last_push_approval were temporarily reconciled to 0 and false for the exact-head merge only, then restored to 1 and true immediately after merge. No other protection setting changed.
